race.comment: SPEED ENCORE (12) handy filly resuming for her second preparation. Went under narrowly on debut when second over 1000m at Muswellbrook in the Miss Finland last May. Primed with the two searching trials and race experience will take her a long way here. PARTY REBEL (3) four-year-old Night Of Thunder mare from Cross Bench on debut for the Messara & Gavranich yard. Has shown ability in the trials and the cross-over nose band and lugging bit go on. Respect. STREET LYRIC (17) slow into stride on resumption when a battling fifth over 1000m at Gosford. Fitter now in a weaker contest. LILIYA (7) is a Russian Revolution filly from a High Chaparral mare, making her debut for the Kris Lees camp. Looks ready to go after a host of solid trials.
